product_profile.summary: The specification establishes a rear lamp module for an M1 passenger car that integrates rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions plus a retro-reflector and outer lens in one housing, and lists representative (to-be-confirmed) materials for the lens, housing, reflector surface, retro-reflector, light source, seals and fasteners. No drawings were supplied. Nothing is established about photometric or electrical values, colours per function, mounting geometry, light-source replaceability, approval status, or any additional functions such as a rear fog lamp or direction indicator.
